Container.Name: campwatch
Container.Overview:
Config-driven GoingToCamp cancellation watcher + auto-hold. Watches campgrounds (default: Washington State Parks) for cancellations matching your dates, can fire ONE hold request to lock an opening to your account for the ~15-minute hold window, and notifies you (Home Assistant webhook / Pushover / ntfy) with a direct booking link. Never automates payment - you complete checkout by hand.
SETUP BEFORE FIRST START: put config.yaml (copy config.example.yaml from the project repo) and, for auto-hold watches, a holds/ folder with your captured hold templates into the appdata path below. Full walkthrough in the README: https://github.com/mosschief/camp-checker#readme
The container fails fast with a clear error list if the config is invalid - check the container log if it won't stay started. dry_run defaults to true; no hold is ever sent until you deliberately flip it.
Container.Requires: config.yaml (and holds/ for auto-hold watches) in the appdata folder - see the project README.

Config.Name: Appdata (config.yaml + holds/)
Config.Description: Folder containing config.yaml and the holds/ directory with captured hold templates.

Config.Name: Status/API Port
Config.Description: Receiver port: /status dashboard, /healthz, and the camply webhook.

Config.Name: Config path (advanced)
Config.Description: Path to config.yaml inside the container. Leave as-is unless you moved it.

Config.Name: HA_WEBHOOK_URL
Config.Description: Home Assistant webhook URL (only if a sink in config.yaml references it).

Config.Name: PUSHOVER_PUSH_TOKEN
Config.Description: Pushover app token (only if a sink references it).

Config.Name: PUSHOVER_PUSH_USER
Config.Description: Pushover user key (only if a sink references it).

Config.Name: NTFY_TOPIC
Config.Description: ntfy topic (only if a sink references it).

Config.Name: NTFY_SERVER
Config.Description: Optional self-hosted ntfy server URL; defaults to https://ntfy.sh.

Config.Name: SESSION_WA_PRIMARY_COOKIE
Config.Description: Session cookie for the 'wa_primary' session (auto-hold watches only). Add more SESSION_<NAME>_COOKIE/_CSRF variables for additional sessions named in config.yaml.

Config.Name: SESSION_WA_PRIMARY_CSRF
Config.Description: Anti-CSRF / request-verification token for the 'wa_primary' session (auto-hold watches only).
